title: Your King Says Pass
setup: Black's king is on g8, a pawn on f2 is about to promote and another sits on g5; both your rooks are on the kingside.
hint: Every piece move you can find spoils something. There is one piece left that can move without cost.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ke7}} covers f8 and hands Black the move. {{f1=Q}} is the best try among Black's six moves and it arrives on the wrong side of the board; {{Rxg5#}} mates. The hardest waiting moves are the ones made by the king.
